name: Survey tile in Sextans
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.4 degrees south of the ecliptic in Sextans, imaged by SPHEREx 17 times in 5 visits over 25 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 21 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 25 hours starting 2025-04-28, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.62 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
